high_level_description: The image is a split-screen photo featuring a person dressed in a Halloween costume. The individual is wearing a white, strapless, ruffled dress that extends to the knees. They have long, dark hair and are accessorized with fingerless gloves that have a cute, cartoonish design resembling a blue character with a pink nose and cheeks. The person is also wearing a headband with similar blue character designs. In the background, there are other people, some of whom are also dressed in costumes, suggesting a festive or party-like atmosphere.
